snippet.title: HauntedPS1 Demo-Disc: Flipside Frights - Trailer
snippet.description:
Http://demodisc.eek3.xyz

The disc sits awkwardly in your hands. Its weight rolls anxiously, like a ball of mercury.
Rainbow oil slicks writhe across micro-etched plastic, splintering your reflection into a billion
delirious strands. Your fingers trace the disc's edge, craving the flip - but your joints seize, as
though your body remembers what your mind fought to forget. Through your television's
hungry static rises a choked cackle between laughter and panicked screams.
Two sides. Two truths.

See you on the flipside.

The Haunted PS1 Demo Disc: Flipside Frights is the fourth iteration of The Haunted PS1
Demo Disc project.
The previous demo discs are, in chronological order:
● Haunted PS1 Demo Disc 2020 (2020)
● Haunted PS1 Demo Disc 2021 (2021)
● Demo Disc: Spectral Mall (2022)
The project first began as a means of promoting in-development or released projects from
the Haunted PS1, a game developer community focused on making games inspired by ones
from the 32-bit era. The project takes the form of a launcher which boots different games,
each from a different developer or team. Many projects featured in the first demo disc have
received critical acclaim.
The second demo disc expanded on the idea of the first one by not just being a menu, but
also featuring even more demos, secret games, and a 3D environment to explore in the
launcher itself. The third one, once more elaborated on the execution of its predecessors’
ideas by featuring an atmospheric environment featuring randomized progression and
puzzles. All demo discs received extensive press coverage from major gaming outlets.
Following the release of Spectral Mall, however, members of the original development team
felt burnt out, so the project went on hiatus for a year. Once revived in 2024, a decision was
made to go back to the basics to figure out a demo disc project which was both less taxing
on the launcher developers and still fulfilling the promise of the demo disc project.
As primarily a horror game development community, previous HPS1 “DDs” featured mainly
horror or atmospheric games. The Haunted PS1 Demo Disc: Flipside Frights aims to show
the audiences not just horror games but also games lighter in tone. The difference in tone is
represented by two sides of the disc: NIGHTMARES and DREAMS–hence the name,
Flipside Frights.
We sincerely hope you’ll enjoy it!

Featured Game Demos

Blessed Burden by Podoba Interactive
Death in Abyss by Agelvik
Eclipsium by Housefire
FriendShapes by RainingLamppost
The Hungry Fly by Erupting Avocado
Juice by Colorfiction
The Lacerator by Games From The Abyss
No Strings Attached Redux by Vladimere Lhore
No Players Online by BEESWAX GAMES
Sorrow by Kris Lee
Spyrit Walker by Rexoto Games
Subversive Memories by Southward Studio
500 Caliber Contractz by Bryce Bucher
Aether Singularity by Alenar Soft
Angeline Era by Analgesic Productions
Axyz by Space Lion Studios
Children of Saturn by Boie and Shoray
Forklift Flowerpot by Too Much Tomato
Last Time I Saw You by Maboroshi Artworks
Prison of Husks by Hexosphere
Scissors In Hell by Z. Bill
Ticky’s Tower of Time by Pizza Dev
Toree Saturn by Siactro
Trip by Bastien Mahaut (BASTINUS REX)
